CVE-2026-14164.1889d51f0d1680672016a801e9d65799eb5fc5dc:
libs: libarchive: 3.8.1 -> 3.8.9 (#9095)

Bumps the vendored libarchive from 3.8.1 to 3.8.9.

3.8.9 is the current libarchive patch release. It rolls up a number of
reader/writer robustness fixes, most notably a double-free in the RAR5
reader fixed in 3.8.8 via libarchive#3071
(https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/pull/3071) — assigned
CVE-2026-14164.

osquery reaches libarchive's readers with full format auto-detection
(RAR5 included) through the jetbrains_plugins table, which parses files
under a user's plugin directories, so this fix is worth picking up. See
tracking issue #9081.

What is changed:

- Submodule `libraries/cmake/source/libarchive/src` → `27cbc78` (v3.8.9)
- `libraries/third_party_libraries_manifest.json` → version/commit
bumped to 3.8.9
- Version-string macros bumped 3.8.1 → 3.8.9 in the six per-platform
`config/*/config.h` overlays

The set of non-test source files is unchanged between 3.8.1 and 3.8.9,
so the explicit source list in
`libraries/cmake/source/libarchive/CMakeLists.txt` needs no changes
(unlike the 3.7.9→3.8.1 bump in #8642, which had a file
rename/addition).

Closes #9081 since this fix resolves it.
Also closes #9082, closes #8901, and closes #8767, even though they were
determined already to not affect osquery. If this PR merges after #9094
then it might be worth cleaning up the ignore list for libarchive.

CVE-2026-40025.4062eed009261cc8f6ad6ce8131bbb8845e7c6aa:
libs: sleuthkit: 4.11.0 -> 4.15.0 (#9097)

Bumps the vendored sleuthkit (The Sleuth Kit) from 4.11.0 to 4.15.0.

4.15.0 fixes two out-of-bounds reads that are reachable through
osquery's `device_file` / `device_hash` / `device_partitions` tables
(which open a device path and let TSK auto-detect the filesystem):

- CVE-2026-40025 — OOB read in the APFS keybag `wrapped_key_parser` (fix
`8b9c9e7d4`); tracked in #8829 / #8905.
- CVE-2026-40026 — OOB read + infinite loop in the ISO9660
`parse_susp()` parser (fix `a95b0ac21`); tracked in #8836 / #8906.

The version update also includes fixes for CVE-2026-40024 (`tsk_recover`
path traversal — a CLI tool osquery doesn't build, see #8828/#8904) and
additional NTFS bounds hardening.

What changed:

- Submodule `libraries/cmake/source/sleuthkit/src` → `01de0345`
(`sleuthkit-4.15.0`)
  - `libraries/third_party_libraries_manifest.json` → 4.15.0
- Version strings (`PACKAGE_STRING`/`PACKAGE_VERSION`/`VERSION`) bumped
to 4.15.0 in the four
`config/{macos,linux}/{aarch64,x86_64}/tsk/tsk_config.h` overlays
- `CMakeLists.txt`: four source files added. In 4.15.0 the core
`tsk/fs/fs_open.c` and `tsk/img/raw.c` unconditionally call new
encryption/logical-filesystem helpers, so these previously-unreferenced
files are now required to link:
    - `tsk/fs/encryptionHelper.cpp`, `tsk/fs/logical_fs.cpp`
    - `tsk/img/logical_img.c`, `tsk/util/file_system_utils.c`

BitLocker (`tsk/util/Bitlocker/*`) and LVM pool support are not compiled
— they're gated behind `HAVE_LIBMBEDTLS`, which osquery's `tsk_config.h`
does not define, so no new dependency (`mbedtls`) is introduced. For
osquery's raw block-device access, these new paths are effectively
no-ops.

Closes #8829 #8905 #8836 #8906 (the exposed CVEs this PR fixes)
Closes #8828 #8904 (tsk_recover) (not-affected and also handled by the
ignore-list PR)

CVE-2026-27171.3f4132c1db22764ac69c83d2834ebe73d83cde64:
libs: zlib: 1.3.1 -> 1.3.2 (#9096)

Bumps the vendored zlib from 1.3.1 to 1.3.2.

zlib 1.3.2 is the current release. It fixes CVE-2026-27171 — unbounded
CPU consumption in `crc32_combine64` / `crc32_combine_gen64`, where
`x2nmodp` performs right shifts in a loop with no termination condition
("zlib before 1.3.2"). osquery compiles `crc32.c`, and those
`crc32_combine*` functions are linked into the binary, so this is the
meaningful fix for us (tracking issue #8778).

It also moots CVE-2026-22184, a global buffer overflow in the
`contrib`/`untgz` demonstration utility (issue #8920) — osquery does not
build `contrib`/`untgz`, so it was never affected, but 1.3.2 removes any
ambiguity.

### What changed

  - Submodule libraries/cmake/source/zlib/src → da607da (v1.3.2)
- libraries/third_party_libraries_manifest.json → version/commit bumped
to 1.3.2

The set of compiled source files (the 15 .c files in CMakeLists.txt) is
unchanged between 1.3.1 and 1.3.2, and `zconf.h`/`zlib.h` are consumed
directly from the submodule, so no build-file or overlay changes are
needed.

### Closes

Closes #8920 (untgz, not-affected) 
Closes #8778 #8921 (CVE-2026-27171) is the crc32 case — this bump
resolves it
